text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
With the combination of the antioxidant

properties of polyphenols and the
energy in
sugar, sweetened tea is the
ideal energy drink...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I would like to add a tad
more sugar
for a more delectable
experience, but well... I
doubt there's
enough liquid to fully dissolve any

additional sugar.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to grin and bear it... No.
Why should
I confine myself to the
restraints of tea and
sugar's current
solubility?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The heretofore unknown, the yet
undetermined
possibilities! I shall
surpass the limits of
solubility... and
reach peak sugar levels!
